title: Increment of a width-constrained binary word
statement: Let $w$ and $i$ be natural numbers with $i<2^w$. The fixed-width increment of the width-$w$ little-endian binary word representing $i$ is the width-$w$ word representing $i+1$ if $i+1<2^w$, and has no result otherwise.
replaced:
For $i < 2^w$, the fixed-width increment of the width-$w$ binary word of $i$ equals
the width-$w$ word of $i+1$ when $i + 1 < 2^w$, and reports overflow otherwise.
This includes width zero.
